name: agent_rcd
_description: Fase B.2 plan Opus: Estudio de Gestion de Residuos RD 105/2008. Calcula estimacion residuos LER 17 segun coeficientes oficiales + LLM para plan gestion. Patron Draft/Commit (rcd_studies_draft -> rcd_studies tras aprobacion humana). Alerta amianto obligatoria si edificio < 2002 con demolicion.

parameters.query:
SELECT id, name, project_type, location_province, location_city,
       property_type, property_area_m2, urgency,
       metadata->>'notes' AS notes,
       (metadata->>'edad_edificio')::int AS edad_edificio,
       metadata->>'sistema_constructivo' AS sistema_constructivo
FROM projects WHERE id = $1::uuid LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO agent_executions (project_id, agent_name, status, started_at, input, metadata)
VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_rcd', 'running', now(), $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb) RETURNING id

INSERT INTO rcd_studies_draft (
  project_id, tenant_id, tipo_obra, superficie_m2,
  estimacion_residuos, total_toneladas,
  plan_gestion, gestores_autorizados, coste_gestion_eur,
  alertas_peligrosos, draft_content, status
) VALUES (
  $1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3, $4::numeric,
  $5::jsonb, $6::numeric,
  $7::jsonb, $8::jsonb, $9::numeric,
  $10::jsonb, $11::jsonb, 'draft'
) RETURNING id, created_at

UPDATE agent_executions
SET status = 'completed',
    finished_at = now(),
    output = $2::jsonb,
    metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || $3::jsonb
WHERE id = $1::uuid
